capstones.name: Spire of the Warlord
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +40% melee damage, +25% accuracy, +15% critical chance.
capstones.description: The warlord ascends the spire and channels the power of Alaris itself.

capstones.name: Holyforge
capstones.effect: For 5 minutes, weapon gains +50% damage, procs a 300-point holy damage strike. Undead take double.
capstones.description: The paladin's weapon is forged in holy fire.

capstones.name: Unholy Aura Discipline
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, Harm Touch/Leech Touch damage +100%, lifetap effectiveness +50%.
capstones.description: An unholy aura wreathes the shadowknight, amplifying their darkest strikes.

capstones.name: Zan Fi's Whistle
capstones.effect: For 3 minutes, +30% attack speed, +20% damage, -50% hate generation.
capstones.description: The whistle of the grandmaster — speed without fury, damage without hate.

capstones.name: Thief's Eyes
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +30% accuracy, +25% critical chance, see invisible/hidden.
capstones.description: The rogue sees everything — no lock, no trap, no hidden foe escapes these eyes.

capstones.name: Reckless Abandon
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, +60% melee damage, +20% accuracy. Take +15% damage. Cannot be stunned.
capstones.description: The berserker abandons all reckoning — pure offense, no retreat.

capstones.name: Flaming Arrows
capstones.effect: For 5 minutes, bow attacks deal +40% damage as fire. 20% chance to proc a 500-point fire strike.
capstones.description: The ranger's arrows burn with the fire of the Veil.

capstones.name: Protection of the Warder
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, beastlord and warder share damage (50/50 split). Both gain +25% mitigation.
capstones.description: Master and warder become one — no blow falls on one alone.

capstones.name: Cacophony
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, personal DPS +40%, nearby enemies take -15% to all resists.
capstones.description: The bard's cacophony shatters focus and resistance alike.

capstones.name: Sanctified Blessing
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, 40% chance for each heal to grant the target a 1000-point damage shield (rune) for 30 seconds.
capstones.description: The cleric's blessing sanctifies each healing touch with protective light.

capstones.name: Wrath of the Wild
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, spell damage +50%, cold/fire DoTs tick 25% faster.
capstones.description: The wild's wrath flows unchecked through the druid.

capstones.name: Prophetic Guard
capstones.effect: Group buff (10 min): +3000 HP, +25% mitigation, +20 to all resists.
capstones.description: The spirits show the shaman what is coming — and how to endure it.

capstones.name: Phantasmal Opponent
capstones.effect: Summon 3 phantasmal duplicates of the target for 1 minute. They attack the original at 40% damage.
capstones.description: The enemy faces itself — and finds itself wanting.

capstones.name: Servant of Ro
capstones.effect: Summon a powerful fire servant for 2 minutes. Deals heavy fire damage, immune to fire.
capstones.description: The Tyrant of Fire lends the magician a servant of living flame.

capstones.name: Gift of Deathly Resolve
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, DoTs have 30% chance to twincast (double damage, no extra mana).
capstones.description: Death itself resolves to double the necromancer's decay.

capstones.name: Arcane Destruction
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, spell damage +45%, mana cost -25%.
capstones.description: Arcane destruction unbound — power at a discount.
